featured_title: Moving to Estero FL: The 2026 Complete Commute Guide
featured_excerpt: Estero puts the airport, FGCU, two hospital systems, and the Gulf beaches within about 3 to 11 miles in a straight line, but which side of I-75 you live on and which road you depend on in season shape your daily drive more than the mileage. The new Three Oaks Parkway link, the Corkscrew Road widening, and I-75 express lanes all change the map in 2026 and 2027.
others_caption: Also this week: moving in 2027 and Amendment 3, how to read a CDD budget, West Bay Club, Copper Oaks, Miromar Lakes vs Grandezza, the best agent in Estero, Fountain Lakes, whether Estero prices have hit bottom, fall 2026 home sales, and Rookery Pointe.
